name: Goldback Exchange Rate
author: Ideal Managed Solutions

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Unzip it and upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Open WordPress admin – Plugins and click “Activate” next to the plugin
  4. Activate & open plugin’s settings page located in the left navigation menu
sections.faq:
Who is this plugin for?

For anyone who wants to display the current Goldback exchange rate on their site.

Will this plugin slow my site down?

Absolutely not.

Will it work on my theme?

Sure! It works with all themes.

Will it work with my plugins?

Sure! It works with all plugins.

What changes will it make to my site?

During installation a table will be created in your sites database to hold the current Goldback exchange rate values. Should you decide to remove the Goldback Exchange Rate plugin, this table is deleted as part of the uninstall process.

sections.description:
External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain the current Goldback Exchange Rate information, which is needed to show the exchange rate information in the included shortcode. This API does not collect any information about you or your users, it only provides the updated exchange information which this plugin uses to update the Goldback Exchange Rate database table. This API service is provided by “Ideal Managed Solutions, LLC”. Terms of use can be found at https://idealmanagedsolutions.com/plugins/goldback/api-terms/, privacy policy can be found at https://idealmanagedsolutions.com/plugins/goldback/privacy/. The API can be directly accessed at https://services.idealmsp.com/IMSPlugins/goldback-exchange/goldbackrate.xml
